The inner function changes `p = var.loc[:, idx] * efficiency[idx]` to `p = -var.sel(name=idx) * efficiency[idx]`, adding an unconditional minus sign. Thus a branch with nonzero flow and nonzero port efficiency can produce the opposite transmission value for the same input, including under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`.
